critical_code_review_comments: ReportIn.description still has no Field(min_length=20, max_length=2000) at backend (server.py ~399). Frontend enforces the 20-char minimum but a direct API caller can bypass. Carried over from iteration_10 — still unaddressed.
POST /api/reports does not cross-check payload target_role against target['role'] from DB. A malicious payload can poison admin filters. Carried over from iteration_10.
users.flagged_by_reports never resets after admin dismisses reports, so flagged state monotonically accumulates. Carried over from iteration_10.
SEO content lazy generation = up to 184 categories × 23 cities = ~4232 LLM calls on first crawl. No background pre-warm or queue. Carried over from iteration_10.
server.py is 3733 lines (single file) — still not modularized. Carried over from iteration_10.
